reviews.text: Magnolia was fantastic from beginning to end. Their team kept us up to date through the whole permitting/planning phase. After that, they had their subs lined up and ready to go so there wasn’t a delay between phases. They made our process turnkey, final pricing was right on budget and they were hands on and responsive the whole time. Can’t recommend Dakota, Michael, and the whole team enough!
reviews.author: Brandon King

reviews.text: The team at Magnolia Fence & Patio did a superb job replacing our backyard retaining wall and fence.  The stone work looks great and the board on board fence was hand built on site and looks awesome.  The teams started and got everything completed as scheduled.
reviews.author: J. Carter

reviews.text:
From the outset, I dealt with Jordan in soliciting his bid, then subsequently to schedule the installation of our 8' high wood screening fence. He was very responsive, keeping us informed about pricing and scheduling, and it all happened just as we'd agreed. Every step of the way was handled professionally.
Devon and his helper installed the fence. He informed us about the entire process, let us know when we could expect completion, and spoke to us in a very friendly and respectful manner. We could not have been happier with the outcome.
I am an architect in business for myself, and I know how important it is to make sure our clients are informed throughout the design and construction process. Magnolia Fence & Patio and their team eceeded my expectations.
I strongly recommend this company to anyone who wants the highest quality of service.
reviews.author: Joe Halbach

reviews.text: Guys showed up around noon. They worked consistently until they were done. I had a patio area fenced, fence put around my ac unit, and a larger gate put in so I could access my back yard. I would highly recommend them. Collin was very nice & respectful to me as a widow of a veteran & my boyfriend who is an army veteran.
reviews.author: Louise Randall

reviews.text:
I am so happy with the service that Magnolia provided with the installation of my new gate and fence. Very professional,  knowledgeable and service oriented.
Extra shout out to Collin for all your help and diligence!

Update- Magnolia did such great work with the gate and iron fence, I asked them to install a wood fence on a difficult elevation. They did a fantastic job! I am very happy with the terrific result. Thanks Collin for your insight and thoughts! Thanks for professional work of the crew!
reviews.author: b h

reviews.text:
Magnolia rebuilt a large double gate and added height to both the gate and fence going from 6 ft to around 9 ft in some places.

I’d say this job had a lot of custom aspects due to utilizing some preexisting features of our old fence.  Collin understood exactly what needed to be done during our initial planning meeting.  That information was perfectly conveyed to the build team.

Excellent workmanship.  Very timely. Very professional.

The price was reasonable for what we asked for and received.  If you’re looking for a high value, premium fence that is well constructed then you must use  Magnolia.
reviews.author: Christopher Moore

reviews.text: This has been a great experience for me. First Magnolia fence & Patio built me very nice pergola. Then another crew came a few days later to rebuild my fence gate. That crew did an excellent job. I had the stain/paint for the gate and it looks great! New wood and hardware and functional gate now!
reviews.author: Luanne Payne

reviews.text: Our new fence with Magnolia was a fantastic experience from start to finish. Collin walked through all aspects of the estimate with me so I was able to understand where I might be able to save a little money. The team had great attention to detail from their demolition to the construction of our new beautiful fence. They wrestled around a tree that I really wanted to keep, and they cleaned up beautifully after the construction. There was really no trace that they left on the property. We wish we had gone ahead and replaced the old fence earlier.
reviews.author: Linda Thompson
